purpose: Raw-image, human-only visible-change record for cabinet inspection images not covered by the earlier material-2 qualitative standard. It is a future review oracle, not an electrical diagnosis, training label, threshold-calibration set, hit-rate, false-positive-rate, or production metric.

annotation_protocol.method: The reviewer compared only the raw reference and raw inspection image side by side. No registration output, candidate region, heatmap, DINO, SAM3, or prior algorithm output was displayed.
annotation_protocol.unit: One visually separable altered conductor/component group. Broad AI re-rendering, labels, text and viewpoint differences are never counted as local groups.
annotation_protocol.coordinate_space: Each inspection is resized to its own reference image size solely for manual review; boxes are [left, top, right, bottom] in that reference-sized canvas, without geometric registration.
annotation_protocol.eligibility: All included local groups are qualitative-only because the images are AI-generated variants with broad incidental changes. They must not be pooled into a numeric algorithm evaluation.

materials.already_covered: cabinet_material2_qualitative_manual_standard_v1.json covers four other material-2 inspection images.

limits: This is a human visual change record, not proof of electrical disconnection, terminal identity, continuity, or miswiring.
The source images are AI-generated variants with broad nonlocal changes, so only the named visually separable local groups are recorded.
The three overlay-contaminated files are recorded for traceability but deliberately excluded from testing.
